standard.description: Configuration file for standard MCP servers. Used as the default when no config type is specified.

multiserver.description: Configuration file that defines multiple MCP servers and their parameters under `mcpServers` field.

fastmcp.description: Configuration file for specialized FastMCP servers, adding source, environment, and deployment settings.

sandbox.description: Configuration file for sandboxed MCP server, adding execution isolation, environment constraints, and related runtime settings.

dev.description: Local development environment with relaxed isolation and enabled debugging.

semi-prod.description: Pre-production environment used for integration testing and validation.

prod.description: Production environment with full security, isolation, and deployment constraints.

universal_job_fields.description: Fields that apply to every job type regardless of connector.

filesystem.description: Local filesystem MCP server used for reading and interacting with files in the current working directory.
filesystem.notes: Uses the official @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem package via npx. Only approved for non-production environments due to data sensitivity.

arxiv-research.description: Custom arXiv research MCP server to grab topical papers in research-oriented workflows.

fetch.description: Fetch MCP server used for retrieving and processing remote web content or other fetchable resources.

fastmcp-docs.description: Custom FastMCP documentation server used for querying and navigating FastMCP documentation and examples.

github.description: GitHub MCP server for repository, branch, issue, and pull request workflows.

control-center.description: Internal Control Center MCP server — exposes jobs, runs, and trigger capabilities so MCPAgent can orchestrate workflows without an OpenAI function-calling loop.

sql-mcp.description: Custom FastMCP SQL server that connects to any user-supplied database (PostgreSQL, SQLite, Snowflake). Connection details are provided at job creation time; the driver is selected via SQL_DB_DRIVER.
